rulings.R1: Already met, no change: segment 1 states the idea in general form ('Nine questions come before any code, and they are the same nine whatever the topic') and names two other questions from the same week (flagging publishers with suspicious traffic, forecasting ticket volume).
rulings.R3: Brief rewritten as a template (118 words) with slots for the question, how many cases and how often, the outcome window, today's rule or report, the segments, and what must not be decided on. It now asks for an answer to all nine questions (prediction or cause, the segments and the untouched slice were missing). Every earlier demand kept.
rulings.R4: Recap is 49 spoken words, two sentences, cue markers removed, the one-page table kept. There is no next lesson, so the second sentence points onward with the outline's three names (recommendation, deeper causal methods, deep learning).
rulings.R5: Keyed answer is the longest option in 3 of 10. No literal 'nothing is wrong' options existed; the three that only endorsed the output shown were replaced with specific wrong moves: quiz 1 ('Sound: ...'), quiz 4 ('Agree: ...'), review 1 variant 2 ('That average is right: ...'). Whys extended. Keyed positions unchanged.
rulings.R6: Segment 8, one added sentence for the move that sat only in other_ways: 'Often the best first request is smaller still: the baseline and the scoreboard, no model, so you learn what the cheap method scores.'
rulings.R7: Audit list regrouped as Frame / Score / Trust / Stop so four lines cover the nine questions. 'Fixed before any model is fitted' was a promise; it is now 'written in the plan before any model is fitted, and every later result repeats them unchanged', which can be checked on the page. The stop condition must be a number.
rulings.specific: Standing-instruction request: the brief and the four audit lines contain nothing course-specific and can be pasted as they are. Segment 8's five things now mirror them: the decision; the kind of problem with one other framing; row, target, timeline; baseline, measure, held-out rows and stop condition; and how it will be trusted (segments to cut by, prediction or cause, the untouched slice).
